rationale: Every reachable non-Advanced workflow and required outcome needs evidence. Repeating every outcome in all four input modes is not the default gate: shared interaction patterns can be qualified once with an explicit source/behavior crosswalk. Unrun behavior never becomes passed through reuse.
requiredGates: Every workflow has actual ordinary-path browser evidence, or an explicit reviewed external capability/product limit.
All663 inventoried outcomes remain individually accountable; safety, failure, stale-owner and pending/unknown effects are targeted mandatory proofs where applicable.
Every unique input/navigation pattern has appropriate compact and keyboard/touch qualification.
A shared-pattern claim covers only its tested layout/input behavior, never the target workflow effect, scope, data identity or unrun state.
Keep source/build/fixture/provider/real-device limits attached to every observation.
